evidence: Four scenario hashes reproduced exactly in a remote browser; counts match the original (225 blocks, 174 pickups, 84 cars). Shift, delivery, results, touch, resize and audio-suspend probes: tests/browser/audit-fix/drift-and-deliver-port.spec.ts (remote software GL), unit tests in tests/unit/drift-and-deliver-port/.
limits: Verified in remote software WebGL2 (SwiftShader) only, not on a hardware GPU; frame rate on real devices is unmeasured.
Touch controls checked with emulated touch at 390x844, not on a physical phone or tablet.
Procedural art; independent reconstruction of the mechanics, not a pixel-parity or 1:1 port. Pedestrians are static, the original's story, police and on-foot play are not ported.
Traffic follows, yields and keeps right by rule; it does not react to the player's car (the player is shoved on contact).

checks.name: mounts examples port without code duplication
